text: {"label": "Delays to Reinforcement and Delay Tolerance","definition": "Work examining how signaled, unsignaled and progressive delays between responding and reinforcement affect response rate, timing and maintenance, and procedures for teaching individuals to tolerate such delays.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on the response-reinforcer delay itself, not general response-reinforcer correlation, interval schedule performance, or alternative-behavior reinforcement treatments for problem behavior."}
